assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-4103 during cleaning and preparation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4103 and PT-4103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 21 August 2018 an incident occurred on P-4103 and PT-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
